description: Build cron expressions with plain-English preview.

faqs.a: No. This builder supports every (*), specific value lists, ranges and steps — the most common cron syntax. Special characters like L, W and # are not supported.
faqs.q: Does it support every cron feature?

faqs.a: The next run times are found by scanning forward minute by minute (up to a year ahead), so they are exact for the schedule you built — but they are labeled approximate because month lengths and daylight-saving quirks vary by system.
faqs.q: Are the next run times exact?

faqs.a: Standard cron OR logic: if you restrict both day-of-month and day-of-week, the job runs when either one matches.
faqs.q: How do day-of-month and day-of-week combine?

howto: For each of the five fields, choose a mode: every, specific values, range or step.
Fill in the values for list, range or step modes.
Read the cron expression and the plain-English description.
